name: mateu
description: Build business UIs with Mateu, the model-driven UI system: declare the model as Java (@UI), C# ([UI]), Python (@ui) or YAML (specs/ui) and Mateu renders forms, CRUDs, wizards, dashboards and app shells. Skills for authoring screens, scaffolding projects, running and verifying them, static bundles and federation.

interface.shortDescription: Build Mateu UIs in Java, C#, Python or YAML
defaultPrompt: Create a Mateu CRUD screen for products.
Build a Mateu UI from YAML with sample data.
